metadata.title: FAFO Inc. tailored baseline: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate + data residency
metadata.remarks: Imports the NIST SP 800-53B Moderate baseline unchanged and adds SA-9(5) (Processing, Storage, and Service Location), which FAFO's data-residency control (fafo-allowed-locations) implements. The SSP (oscal/ssp.json) imports this profile; tests/test_catalog.py proves every crosswalk control is inside it.
